messages.bing: I am a US beginner starting with no equipment. I want two milk-based espresso drinks each morning from whole beans; sequential preparation is fine. Please explore good-value complete setups, emphasizing separate espresso machine and grinder combinations while including integrated alternatives when competitive. The setup must grind suitably for espresso, brew espresso, and steam milk using US household electricity. Manual steaming is fine. Account for required basics such as portafilter, baskets, tamping mechanism and milk vessel, including built-in equivalents; optional upgrades are not required. Explore complete totals around $600 or less as a nonbinding shopping target, not a statement of my maximum budget. Also show higher-priced alternatives if their likely benefits justify the extra cost. Please return useful individual component offers even if your catalog cannot complete every bundle, and identify remaining gaps. I value consistent, enjoyable milk drinks, approachable workflow, reasonable cleaning, dependability and seller recourse. Explain meaningful quality and seller-confidence tradeoffs, including actual seller, condition or variant ambiguity where the cards support it. Distinguish card evidence from assumptions. Favor a small but varied set of existing offers over one premium recommendation; include a cheaper credible alternative. I will compare complete equipment totals before tax and shipping, and may combine components across providers. There will be one follow-up before I decide.

Please expose useful standalone components as well as complete options, since I can combine providers. Give complete equipment totals before tax and shipping where supported, and identify gaps without inventing products. Distinguish card evidence, ordinary package assumptions and uncertainty about seller, condition or variant. There will be one follow-up before I decide.
